property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any _owner argument, calling setOwner(...) on the correct contract always returns true (i.e., the external call completes and returns true); the mutant instead returns true only when the new owner is the zero address, so for non-zero _owner it will return false and violate the rule.
change_summary: Set owner then return the zero address (as a bool via comparison) — return true only if new owner is zero address, changing returned value for non-zero args.
